metrics.name: forge.cgroup.cpu.throttled_periods
metrics.description: CPU quota periods in which the cgroup was throttled.

metrics.name: forge.cgroup.cpu.throttled_time
metrics.description: Time the cgroup was throttled by its CPU quota.

metrics.name: forge.cgroup.memory.limit
metrics.description: The cgroup's memory.max; absent when it is max.

metrics.name: forge.cgroup.memory.oom_kills
metrics.description: Processes the kernel killed for the cgroup's memory limit (memory.events oom_kill).

metrics.name: forge.cgroup.memory.working_set
metrics.description: The cgroup's memory.current minus inactive_file: the kubelet's working set.

metrics.name: forge.cgroup.pids.count
metrics.description: Tasks in the cgroup (pids.current).

metrics.name: forge.cgroup.pids.limit
metrics.description: The cgroup's pids.max; absent when it is max.

metrics.name: forge.cgroup.pressure.avg10
metrics.description: Share of the last ten seconds tasks in the cgroup stalled on a resource, from 0 to 1.

metrics.name: forge.cgroup.pressure.stall_time
metrics.description: Time tasks in the cgroup stalled on a resource: some is at least one task, full is every task.

metrics.name: forge.metrics.rejected_attributes
metrics.description: Measurements whose attribute was not in the metric's declaration, corrected before export. A rising value means code records an attribute the schema does not list.

metrics.name: forge.process.file_descriptor.limit
metrics.description: Soft RLIMIT_NOFILE of the process.

metrics.name: forge.process.file_descriptor.utilization
metrics.description: Open file descriptors over the soft limit.

metrics.name: forge.process.handle.count
metrics.description: Open kernel object handles of the process (windows, which has no file descriptors).

metrics.name: forge.process.memory.go_gap
metrics.description: Resident set size minus the memory the Go runtime has mapped: what cgo, mmap and fragmentation hold. Negative when the runtime has mapped more than is resident.

metrics.name: forge.resource.scope
metrics.description: 1 for the view the host metrics report: host (the whole machine) or cgroup (inside a Kubernetes pod, the container only).

metrics.name: forge.server.drain.duration
metrics.description: How long each phase of a graceful shutdown took: the pre-stop pause, the listener drain (unary requests and long-lived streams), stopping workers and operators, the caller's teardown, each node a lifecyclekit supervisor stops (node), and the whole shutdown (total).

metrics.name: forge.system.file_descriptor.count
metrics.description: File handles allocated on the machine.

metrics.name: forge.system.file_descriptor.limit
metrics.description: The machine's file handle limit (fs.file-max).

metrics.name: forge.system.process.count
metrics.description: Processes on the machine.

metrics.name: forge.system.process.limit
metrics.description: The lower of the kernel's pid_max and threads-max.

metrics.name: go.config.gogc
metrics.description: Heap size target percentage configured by the user, otherwise 100.

metrics.name: go.goroutine.count
metrics.description: Count of live goroutines.

metrics.name: go.memory.allocated
metrics.description: Memory allocated to the heap by the application.

metrics.name: go.memory.allocations
metrics.description: Count of allocations to the heap by the application.

metrics.name: go.memory.gc.goal
metrics.description: Heap size target for the end of the GC cycle.

metrics.name: go.memory.limit
metrics.description: Go runtime memory limit configured by the user, when one exists.

metrics.name: go.memory.used
metrics.description: Memory used by the Go runtime.

metrics.name: go.processor.limit
metrics.description: The number of OS threads that can execute user-level Go code simultaneously.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_closed_max_idle
metrics.description: Connections closed because of SetMaxIdleConns.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_closed_max_idle_time
metrics.description: Connections closed because of SetConnMaxIdleTime.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_closed_max_lifetime
metrics.description: Connections closed because of SetConnMaxLifetime.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_idle
metrics.description: Idle connections.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_in_use
metrics.description: Connections currently in use.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_max_open
metrics.description: Maximum number of open connections to the database.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_open
metrics.description: Established connections, in use and idle.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_wait_count
metrics.description: Total number of times a caller waited for a connection.

metrics.name: go.sql.connections_wait_duration
metrics.description: Total time blocked waiting for a new connection.

metrics.name: go.sql.query_timing
metrics.description: Timing of processed database queries.

metrics.name: jobs_in_flight
metrics.description: Jobs running.

metrics.name: order_value
metrics.description: Order value at creation.

metrics.name: orders_created
metrics.description: Orders created.

metrics.name: process.context_switches
metrics.description: Times the scheduler switched away from the process, by whether it yielded.

metrics.name: process.cpu.time
metrics.description: CPU time the process has used, by mode.

metrics.name: process.cpu.utilization
metrics.description: CPU the process used since the previous sample, in cores (above 1 when more than one core is busy).

metrics.name: process.disk.io
metrics.description: Bytes the process caused to be read from or written to storage.

metrics.name: process.memory.usage
metrics.description: Resident set size of the process.

metrics.name: process.memory.virtual
metrics.description: Virtual memory size of the process.

metrics.name: process.paging.faults
metrics.description: Page faults the process has taken, by type.

metrics.name: process.thread.count
metrics.description: OS threads of the process.

metrics.name: process.unix.file_descriptor.count
metrics.description: Open file descriptors of the process.

metrics.name: process.uptime
metrics.description: Time since the process started.

metrics.name: queue_depth
metrics.description: Jobs waiting.

metrics.name: rpc.server.calls
metrics.description: Total RPC calls received.

metrics.name: rpc.server.duration
metrics.description: RPC duration.

metrics.name: rpc.server.errors
metrics.description: Total RPC calls that returned an error, by connect code and error class (server fault, user error, canceled). A call the server ended on purpose (svcerr.ExpectedClose) is not counted.

metrics.name: system.cpu.load_average.15m
metrics.description: Run-queue load average over 15 minutes.

metrics.name: system.cpu.load_average.1m
metrics.description: Run-queue load average over 1 minute.

metrics.name: system.cpu.load_average.5m
metrics.description: Run-queue load average over 5 minutes.

metrics.name: system.cpu.logical.count
metrics.description: Logical CPUs the process may run on, lowered to the cgroup's CPU quota when one is set.

metrics.name: system.cpu.time
metrics.description: CPU time of the whole machine by mode, summed over every CPU. Nice time is counted as user, interrupt time as system.

metrics.name: system.cpu.utilization
metrics.description: Share of all CPU time in each mode since the previous sample, from 0 to 1.

metrics.name: system.filesystem.usage
metrics.description: Space on the volumes the process writes to, by state and by the volume's role (never its path). Free is what an unprivileged process may use.

metrics.name: system.filesystem.utilization
metrics.description: Used space over used plus free, per volume role.

metrics.name: system.linux.memory.available
metrics.description: The kernel's estimate of memory available to a new workload without swapping (MemAvailable).

metrics.name: system.memory.limit
metrics.description: Memory the process may use: the cgroup's memory.max when set, otherwise the machine's total.

metrics.name: system.memory.usage
metrics.description: Memory of the machine by state; cached is page cache, buffers and reclaimable slab, and the three add up to the total.

metrics.name: system.paging.usage
metrics.description: Swap space of the machine by state.
